# Button

> **Status: EARLY** — HTML7 early-release component API.

A native button with Looma presentation.

- Invocation: `<looma-button>`
- Native element: `<button>`
- Contract schema: `1`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Target | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `sm` \| `md` \| `lg` | no | `"md"` | attribute `data-lm-size` | Control size. |
| `variant` | `outline` \| `solid` \| `destructive` \| `ghost` | no | `"outline"` | attribute `data-lm-variant` | Visual treatment. |

Native attributes and framework-native event surfaces pass through to the native root. Declared prop targets and template-owned attributes take precedence.

## Usage

```html

```

